neighbours.label: ' all' in 'all around (us/them)': surrounding everywhere
fire: If you look closely, history is visible all around us in the old streets.
Tiny insects live all around them in the leaf litter of the forest.
The signs of autumn were all around her as she walked home.
Opportunities for learning are all around children every single day.
Bacteria are all around us, on every surface we touch.
Music seemed to come from all around him in the crowded square.
Reminders of the war were all around the village for decades.
When you hike in spring, wildflowers bloom all around you.
